stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS fall 2024 (exact counts from the NCES ADM2024 file via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal; percentages and percentiles from College Navigator). No Common Data Set was found on UWA's site (the Institutional Effectiveness pages link none), so international applicants/admits, GPA, SAT total and admission factors are not included. SAT/ACT percentiles cover enrolled first-time students who submitted scores (SAT 3%, ACT 61%); the SAT figures rest on very few students. The 43% admit rate is as IPEDS reports it; UWA's published minimums are low (ACT 17, SAT 920 or 2.5 GPA), so the counting of applicants may differ from other schools.

cost.notes: College Navigator (IPEDS 2024-25): published tuition and fees $10,990 in-state, $20,090 out-of-state; on-campus food and housing $8,230; books and supplies $1,206. Current 2026-27 direct costs for international undergraduates are on the UWA Tuition & Fees page (see cycle data).
